Construction of the new city of Sem-Port has begun in the Republic of Estell

[Sem-Port City, February 21, 2025]  Today, the Republic of Estell launched a large-scale project to build the new city of Sem-Port, which will become a symbol of modern urbanism, technological progress and sustainable development. The project, initiated by the government of Estell, is intended to solve the problems of overcrowding in large cities and to create a new economic and cultural center on the North Sea coast. Sem-Port will be built on the northernmost point of the Amaralo mainland.

The construction of the City has already created thousands of jobs, and once the project is completed, the city will be home to more than 500,000 people. Sem-Port is expected to attract major international investment. The city's port area will become a key hub for maritime trade in the region.

At the groundbreaking ceremony, the President of the Republic of Estell said: "Sem-Port is not just a city, it is a vision for our future."
